inspiration.source_location: deltas CTE in the first WITH statement: SELECT par.id, par.last_elapsed_time - SUM(chi.last_elapsed_time) ... FROM sq par LEFT OUTER JOIN sq chi ON chi.parent_id = par.id GROUP BY par.id, par.last_elapsed_time, ...; the combined CTE then joins sq to deltas and wraps every self metric in NVL(self, own)
inspiration.observed_pattern: An execution-plan renderer derives per-operation self time by subtracting the summed metrics of direct child operations from each parent operation: the plan table self LEFT OUTER JOINs on child.parent_id = parent.id, groups by the parent row, and the final projection falls back to the parent's own accumulated value with NVL because a parent with no matching child rows yields a NULL aggregate, and any arithmetic against that NULL aggregate stays NULL until coalesced.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Rewritten as an original cost-ledger scenario over cost_entries: plan operations become cost entries in a tree whose parent_id is NULL for roots; last_elapsed_time becomes a nullable cost for pending entries; the Oracle LEFT OUTER JOIN is rewritten as a standard LEFT JOIN; NVL becomes COALESCE; SQL*Plus substitution variables become concrete fixture literals; the CTE chain (base, deltas) preserves the original structure; the final projection exposes both the raw nullable subtraction and the coalesced fallback so a zero-versus-null empty aggregate is observable in the result set.

fixture_notes: Nine cost entries form a three-level tree plus one orphan: entry 1 has children 2 (30), 4 (NULL), and 8 (10) so its sum is 40; entry 5 has only the NULL-cost child 6, so its sum is NULL and the fallback restores its own 40; entries 4 and 6 carry NULL cost themselves; entry 3 points at nonexistent parent 42; entry 8's child 9 contributes only to entry 8, not to entry 1, keeping the join direct-child-only.
determinism_notes: Single read-only statement; ORDER BY the unique primary key; no clocks, randomness, or concurrency.
setup: CREATE TABLE cost_entries (id INT PRIMARY KEY, parent_id INT, label VARCHAR(32), cost INT)

INSERT INTO cost_entries VALUES (1, NULL, 'alpha', 100), (2, 1, 'alpha-ops', 30), (3, 42, 'orphan', 7), (4, 1, 'alpha-pending', NULL), (5, NULL, 'beta', 40), (6, 5, 'beta-pending', NULL), (7, NULL, 'gamma', 25), (8, 1, 'alpha-sub', 10), (9, 8, 'alpha-sub-x', 4)

steps.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT id, parent_id, cost FROM cost_entries), deltas AS (SELECT p.id AS id, p.cost AS own_cost, p.cost - SUM(c.cost) AS unexplained_cost FROM base p LEFT JOIN base c ON c.parent_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.cost) SELECT d.id, d.own_cost, d.unexplained_cost, COALESCE(d.unexplained_cost, d.own_cost) AS self_cost FROM deltas d ORDER BY d.id
